function: Learned neural codebook for fronthaul quantization of precoded signals in cell-free massive MIMO; precoder is fixed MMSE, so no area 1-7 function (pp. 4, 19).
notes: Excluded under function. The learned part (neural-MQ, neural codebook trained with Adam) passes no_learning, but it only quantizes already-precoded baseband signals for the DU-RU fronthaul. p. 4: "by focusing solely on fronthaul compression" (the paper says it complements precoding designs). p. 19: "we adopt MMSE precoding and localized MMSE receive beamforming (44)", so the precoder is not learned; alpha-PMQ is a non-learned iterative search. Borderline: if the reviewer reads neural-MQ as non-linear precoding (area 3), the paper uses 3GPP UMi (p. 19), tests other N and SNR (pp. 22-23), gives complexity (Table I, p. 10) and code (p. 17).
